Of course what he doesn't tell you is that 'brand new wok' has already gone through part of the seasoning process, or rather the heat treatment stage, hence the blue colour which is actually the black oxide he's talking about, which shows itself as a bluish hue because of the silver colour beneath, that's the time consuming bit, a normal basic wok doesn't come with that blue hue, they come as plain carbon steel, you need to heat the pan up so it looks burnt, then keep heating it and it goes through oranges, purples, blue, then back to a silver and blue hue.

all he's doing in this video is just heating the pan, burning off some oil so it's polymerised, which is what the dark brown / black colour is, and is the 'seasoning'
